import pandas as pd

# Source file paths
source_files = [
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_45/training_0.csv"
]

# List to hold dataframes from all sources
dfs = []

# Load each source file
for file_path in source_files:
    # Read CSV with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
    df = pd.read_csv(file_path, index_col=0)
    dfs.append(df)

# Since there is only one source table, and it contains all target columns plus extra columns,
# we select only the target columns from it.

# Target schema columns
target_columns = ['Item ID', 'Item Name', 'Price']

# Extract only the target columns from the source dataframe(s)
# Here only one dataframe, so just select columns directly
df_target = dfs[0][target_columns].copy()

# Ensure correct data types as per target schema
df_target['Item ID'] = df_target['Item ID'].astype(int)
df_target['Item Name'] = df_target['Item Name'].astype(str)
df_target['Price'] = df_target['Price'].astype(float)

# Write the result to the target path
output_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_45/target_multisource.csv"
df_target.to_csv(output_path, index=False)

import pandas as pd

# Read source table
source0 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_45/training_0.csv", index_col=0)

# Since only one source table, UNION is trivial (just use the table)
# Group by 'Item ID' and 'Item Name' (leftmost non-float unique columns in target schema)
# Aggregate Price by mean to reduce duplicates and match target tuple count
result = source0.groupby(['Item ID', 'Item Name'], as_index=False).agg({'Price': 'mean'})

# Write output
result.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_45/target_multisource_critique_history.csv", index=False)
